snippet.title: Little Dungeon Stories  - Roguelike card-based RPG (Official Launch Trailer)
snippet.description:
Little Dungeon Stories is a challenging roguelike card-based RPG. Enter the dungeon full of secrets, hostile monsters, deadly traps, and legendary loots. How long can you survive?

Steam Release 4Q 2019. Xbox One, PS4, Nintendo Switch Release 1Q 2020

You would do me a great favor to add Little Dungeon Stories to your wish list on Steam, you will be notified when it is released:
Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1069050/

Game by David Moralejo Sánchez
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BreakfastStudi1

Publisher: GrabTheGames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/GrabTheGames
